content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't need to lift heavy—what matters is taking sets close to failure. You can build solid muscle with moderate weight and higher reps (8-15 range) as long as you're pushing hard. Heavy weight just lets you do that with fewer reps, so it's more time-efficient in the gym.

That said, your goal is 100kg bench in three months, so progressive overload—gradually increasing weight or reps—is key. You'll get there faster mixing heavy strength work with controlled volume. How's your bench pressing been going this week? 💪
